select t.task_id, t.project_id, t.event_id, t.provider, t.pr_number, t.pr_title, t.pr_author, t.source_branch, t.target_branch, t.base_sha, t.head_sha, t.additions, t.deletions, t.changed_files, t.trigger_type, t.task_status, t.review_conclusion, t.current_step, t.failure_step, t.failure_type, t.failure_message, t.attempt_count, t.latest_run_id, t.started_time, t.finished_time, t.duration_ms, t.total_score, t.score_correctness, t.score_security, t.score_practice, t.score_performance, t.score_commit_quality, t.protocol_version, t.focus_issue_count, t.has_critical_security, t.parse_status, t.snapshot_review_mode, t.snapshot_template_id, t.snapshot_template_name, t.snapshot_template_code, t.snapshot_template_version, t.snapshot_model_id, t.snapshot_model_name, t.snapshot_model_provider, t.snapshot_model, t.snapshot_engine_code, t.snapshot_engine_name, p.project_name, bs.system_name as business_system_name, p.repository_owner, p.repository_name, p.repository_url, r.top_issues_json, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time from review_task t inner join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_business_system bs on bs.system_id = p.business_system_id inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id inner join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id left join review_task_run r on r.run_id = t.latest_run_id
mapper.insert: insert into review_task (project_id, event_id, provider, pr_number, pr_title, pr_author, source_branch, target_branch, base_sha, head_sha, additions, deletions, changed_files, trigger_type, task_status, failure_message, attempt_count, snapshot_review_mode, snapshot_template_id, snapshot_template_name, snapshot_template_code, snapshot_template_version, snapshot_prompt_content, snapshot_model_id, snapshot_model_name, snapshot_model_provider, snapshot_model, snapshot_engine_code, snapshot_engine_name, snapshot_scope_exclude_patterns, snapshot_scope_include_tests, snapshot_scope_report_existing, snapshot_scope_expand_enabled, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{eventId}, #{provider}, #{prNumber}, #{prTitle}, #{prAuthor}, #{sourceBranch}, #{targetBranch}, #{baseSha}, #{headSha}, #{additions}, #{deletions}, #{changedFiles}, #{triggerType}, #{taskStatus}, #{failureMessage}, #{attemptCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{snapshotReviewMode}, #{snapshotTemplateId}, #{snapshotTemplateName}, #{snapshotTemplateCode}, #{snapshotTemplateVersion}, #{snapshotPromptContent}, #{snapshotModelId}, #{snapshotModelName}, #{snapshotModelProvider}, #{snapshotModel}, #{snapshotEngineCode}, #{snapshotEngineName}, #{snapshotScopeExcludePatterns}, #{snapshotScopeIncludeTests}, #{snapshotScopeReportExisting}, #{snapshotScopeExpandEnabled}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update review_task set task_status = 'RUNNING', current_step = #{currentStep}, failure_step = null, failure_type = null, failure_message = null, started_time = #{startedTime}, finished_time = null, duration_ms = null, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and (task_status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED') or (task_status = 'RUNNING' and started_time < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{staleRunningMinutes} minute)))

update review_task set task_status = #{taskStatus}, review_conclusion = #{reviewConclusion}, current_step = #{currentStep}, failure_step = #{failureStep}, failure_type = #{failureType}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, latest_run_id = #{latestRunId}, started_time = #{startedTime}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, pr_author = #{prAuthor}, additions = #{additions}, deletions = #{deletions}, changed_files = #{changedFiles}, total_score = #{totalScore}, score_correctness = #{scoreCorrectness}, score_security = #{scoreSecurity}, score_practice = #{scorePractice}, score_performance = #{scorePerformance}, score_commit_quality = #{scoreCommitQuality}, protocol_version = #{protocolVersion}, focus_issue_count = #{focusIssueCount}, has_critical_security = #{hasCriticalSecurity}, parse_status = #{parseStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}

update review_task set snapshot_review_mode = #{snapshotReviewMode}, snapshot_template_id = #{snapshotTemplateId}, snapshot_template_name = #{snapshotTemplateName}, snapshot_template_code = #{snapshotTemplateCode}, snapshot_template_version = #{snapshotTemplateVersion}, snapshot_prompt_content = #{snapshotPromptContent}, snapshot_model_id = #{snapshotModelId}, snapshot_model_name = #{snapshotModelName}, snapshot_model_provider = #{snapshotModelProvider}, snapshot_model = #{snapshotModel}, snapshot_engine_code = #{snapshotEngineCode}, snapshot_engine_name = #{snapshotEngineName}, snapshot_scope_exclude_patterns = #{snapshotScopeExcludePatterns}, snapshot_scope_include_tests = #{snapshotScopeIncludeTests}, snapshot_scope_report_existing = #{snapshotScopeReportExisting}, snapshot_scope_expand_enabled = #{snapshotScopeExpandEnabled}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select:
select date_format(ifnull(t.finished_time, t.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, sum(case when t.task_status = 'SUCCESS' and t.review_conclusion = 'PASS' then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when t.task_status = 'SUCCESS' and t.review_conclusion = 'WARN' then 1 else 0 end) as warnCount, sum(case when t.task_status = 'SUCCESS' and t.review_conclusion = 'BLOCK' then 1 else 0 end) as blockCount, sum(case when t.task_status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failedCount from review_task t inner join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_business_system bs on bs.system_id = p.business_system_id inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id inner join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id where t.task_status in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')
and date_format(ifnull(t.finished_time, t.create_time),'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(ifnull(t.finished_time, t.create_time),'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
${params.dataScope} group by date_format(ifnull(t.finished_time, t.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') order by statDate asc

select count(1) from review_task t inner join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_business_system bs on bs.system_id = p.business_system_id inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id inner join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id where date(t.create_time) = curdate() ${params.dataScope}

select count(1) from review_task t inner join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_business_system bs on bs.system_id = p.business_system_id inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id inner join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id where t.task_status = 'SUCCESS' and date(ifnull(t.finished_time, t.create_time)) = curdate() ${params.dataScope}

select count(1) from review_task t inner join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_business_system bs on bs.system_id = p.business_system_id inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id inner join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id where t.task_status = 'FAILED' and date(ifnull(t.finished_time, t.create_time)) = curdate() ${params.dataScope}

select max(ifnull(t.finished_time, t.create_time)) from review_task t inner join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id left join sys_business_system bs on bs.system_id = p.business_system_id inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id inner join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id where 1 = 1 ${params.dataScope}
where 1 = 1 ${params.dataScope} order by t.task_id desc limit 5
